instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Work out how a person or creator does their thing, such as their style or voice, from what they have made or said", and give it profile_ref (The name the profile record will be kept under); subject_ref (Whose way of doing the thing this is); subject_records (What the subject made or said, read from their records).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:brief-a-profile and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give the profile's name, the subject's name and the subject's own records (what they made or said).
